title: Vibrant Garlicky Jamaican Yam Grill
description: A cozy Jamaican dish featuring garlicky yams grilled to perfection in an agave leaf vessel, this recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Jamaican yams
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together canola oil, garlic, scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced yams to the bowl and toss to coat with the garlicky mixture.
Wrap each yam slice in an agave leaf, making sure to seal the edges securely.
Place the wrapped yams on the grill and cook for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove the yams from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the vibrant garlicky Jamaican yam grill hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
